attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 10) as systemd services with firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened. Verified cross-member write/read consistency, verified continued read/write availability with node3 offline plus catch-up of missed writes on recovery, then performed the mandatory sequential native reboot of all three nodes (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout) with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart proof of etcd health, cluster membership, and data integrity on each.
